summary: Deployment-readiness pass: verified SITE_URL/OG_IMAGE refactor (Seo.jsx), Home and YorbaLinda JSON-LD absolute URLs, canonical/OG/Twitter meta tags, sitemap.xml + robots.txt generated by scripts/gen-seo.js, and prior scroll-to-top regression. All 11 acceptance criteria pass. Zero visual/copy regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Scroll-to-top on route change relies on useEffect, which fires ~1s after navigation on this preview host (network-idle heavy React app). Users see a momentary scroll flash before reset. Consider useLayoutEffect + calling scrollTo synchronously in the click handler for instant reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SITE_URL resolves to https://download-hub-281.preview.emergentagent.com from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All JSON-LD, canonical, og:url, og:image, twitter:image absolute-URL requirements PASS on / and /yorba-linda-smog-check. sitemap.xml and robots.txt both return HTTP 200 via public URL and list all 7 routes with preview base. FAQPage on /yorba-linda-smog-check has 5 questions, /faq has >=8. Homepage AutomotiveBusiness JSON-LD retains aggregateRating 4.8/160, telephone +1-714-993-1660, address 144 S Bradford Ave, sameAs Google Business, openingHoursSpecification, and review array. Landmarks step 1 does NOT mention Valvoline (confirmed via data-testid=lv-landmarks li:nth-child(1)). Note: 'Valvoline' text still appears elsewhere in warning banner and map alt text — that is intended (warning that 'OC Smog Shop by Valvoline is NOT us'). Mascot mix-blend-mode=screen confirmed. Yorba Linda nav link present. No visible $XX prices on Home. Scroll-to-top on YL card click works but takes ~1200ms to settle (settles to 0). Back-button scroll on Home is restored by browser to a saved position (differs from pre-click due to lazy image height shifts) — historical behavior, not a regression.
